education.description_zh: 灰色混凝土連續廊柱、深屋簷與橫向窗帶；保留外掛冷氣與入口雨棚。
education.description_en: Grey concrete piers, deep roof eaves and continuous window bands, with external AC units and an entrance canopy.

general_4.description_zh: 兩層低樓、白灰色立柱、大面窗與平屋簷；入口為薄型平頂雨棚，舊稱研發大樓。
general_4.description_en: A low two-storey block with pale piers, broad windows, flat eaves and a thin entrance canopy; formerly the R&D Building.

main_library.description_zh: 旺宏館以弧形前棟、挑高玻璃穿堂、白色遮陽構件和側面大階梯形成鮮明輪廓。
main_library.description_en: Macronix combines a curved front wing, tall glazed atrium, white sunshades and a broad external stair.

admin_hall.description_zh: 三層白色水平量體，連續深色窗帶與中央入口；前方與大草坪、三角鐘路口相連。
admin_hall.description_en: A low white three-storey facade with dark horizontal ribbon windows and a central entrance near the Campus Green.

engineering_1.description_zh: 淺色長立面、密集水平窗列與中央直向構件；地面層有寬入口柱廊。
engineering_1.description_en: A broad pale facade with dense horizontal window bands, a vertical central division and a wide entrance portico.

chemistry.description_zh: 粉褐色高低錯落量體、綠色玻璃翼與淺色入口門框，窗列與屋頂輪廓和工一不同。
chemistry.description_en: Dusty pink stepped masses, a green-glass wing and a pale entrance portal give Chemistry a distinct silhouette.

chemical_engineering.description_zh: 褐粉色面磚、規整方窗與中央山牆，低斜入口雨棚是化工館的辨識特徵。
chemical_engineering.description_en: Muted rose brick, regular square windows and a raised central parapet, with a low sloping entrance canopy.

clinic.description_zh: 紅褐面磚與淺色直柱交錯，方格窗、細框玻璃雨棚和低樓層比例保留醫輔大樓特徵。
clinic.description_en: Peach brick alternates with pale vertical piers, grouped square windows and a slim glazed entrance canopy.

general_2.description_zh: 白色高樓以水平窗帶、外側直柱和挑高深色玻璃入口為主要特徵，並非低矮教室樓。
general_2.description_en: A tall pale block with ribbon windows, vertical outer piers and a very tall dark-glass entrance atrium.

general_3.description_zh: 淺色矩形框架包圍凹入的深色橫向窗帶，兩側可見窄窗列與中央入口。
general_3.description_en: A pale rectangular outer frame surrounds recessed dark window bands, with narrow side windows and a central entrance.

old_incubator.description_zh: 舊育成中心為兩層粉色面磚低樓，方窗與細柱平頂雨棚呼應照片中的入口。
old_incubator.description_en: The old incubator is a low two-storey pink-tiled building with barred rectangular windows and a flat canopy on slender posts.

mechanical_chemistry.description_zh: 保留舊實驗館的淡褐粉色外牆、階梯式山牆、三列大窗與低樓層輪廓。
mechanical_chemistry.description_en: An older low lab block with muted mauve walls, stepped parapets and three rows of large simple windows.

materials_tech.description_zh: 淡粉色外牆、深矩形窗洞和粗直柱形成凹凸立面，保持分翼及平屋頂輪廓。
materials_tech.description_en: A pale pink facade with deep recessed rectangular windows, heavy piers, stepped wings and flat roof lines.

materials_lab.description_zh: 材料實驗館採低層灰白混凝土量體、淺屋簷與凹入入口，和高樓型館舍區分。
materials_lab.description_en: A low grey-white laboratory with shallow eaves, repetitive windows and a recessed entrance.

alloy_lab.description_zh: 低層米白色實驗館，入口有寬大的平頂柱廊與方形立柱，後方保留低斜屋頂輪廓。
alloy_lab.description_en: A low cream laboratory with a broad flat entrance portico, square columns and a shallow pitched inner roof.

delta_hall.description_zh: 白色高樓、深色水平凹陽台、下部大片玻璃與粉褐色入口框是台達館的識別特徵。
delta_hall.description_en: A tall white block with recessed dark balcony bands, large lower glass bays and a muted rose entrance surround.

physics.description_zh: 淺石色外牆、拱頂窗框、開放式屋頂柱架與錯落樓翼。
physics.description_en: Pale stone walls, arched window surrounds, open rooftop pavilions and stepped wings.

student_center.description_zh: 水木生活中心的白色面磚、圓弧樓梯量體、深窗帶與薄型入口雨棚。
student_center.description_en: Shui Mu has pale tile walls, a curved stair volume, deep window bands and a thin entrance canopy.

dining_hall.description_zh: 小吃部為低矮長形量體，寬出簷、入口格柵與連續窗列形成主要特徵。
dining_hall.description_en: The food court is a long low block with wide eaves, entrance fins and continuous window bands.

gym.description_zh: 體育館保留三組高大玻璃窗、深凹窗框與低矮入口雨棚。
gym.description_en: Three tall glazed bays, recessed surrounds and a low entrance canopy identify the gym.

humanities_building.description_zh: 人社院以紅褐面磚、灰色基座與細長鐘塔構成鮮明輪廓。
humanities_building.description_en: Humanities combines red-brown brick, a grey base and a slender clock tower.

auditorium.description_zh: 大禮堂為層疊白色量體，前方柱廊、水平玻璃窗與寬階梯保留入口特徵。
auditorium.description_en: The auditorium has layered white masses, a front colonnade, horizontal glazing and broad entrance steps.

museum.description_zh: 李存敏館保留層疊露台、淺色網格面與橙色入口框。
museum.description_en: Lee Tsen Min features stepped terraces, pale mesh-like walls and a distinctive orange entrance surround.

computer_science.description_zh: 劉炯朗館以對稱淺色翼樓、規整方窗與入口上方菱形構件區分。
computer_science.description_en: Liu Jiong Lang has symmetrical pale wings, regular square windows and a diamond detail above the entrance.

natural_science.description_zh: 生命科學一館為白色水平窗帶、階梯量體與中央平頂雨棚。
natural_science.description_en: Life Science I has pale horizontal window bands, stepped masses and a central flat entrance canopy.

biomedical.description_zh: 生醫館保留高低雙翼、深色玻璃連接部與直立鐘塔量體。
biomedical.description_en: Biomedical retains tall adjoining wings, a dark glazed connection and a vertical clock-tower volume.

faculty_housing.description_zh: 清華會館保留中央玻璃軸線、兩側突出窗間與入口柱廊。
faculty_housing.description_en: Guest House I retains a central glazed axis, projecting side window bays and an entrance portico.

engineering_2.description_zh: 工程三館的水平窗帶、外側立柱與寬平頂入口柱廊。
engineering_2.description_en: Engineering III has horizontal window bands, outer piers and a broad flat entrance portico.

south_lab.description_zh: 清華實驗室以橫向百葉左翼、中央藍色玻璃量體、粉灰色條帶側翼與外挑連通雨棚重繪。
south_lab.description_en: Tsing Hua Laboratory is redrawn with a louvred left wing, central blue glazing, pink-grey striped wing and projecting connecting canopy.
